title: Hashtag Vocabulary Splitter
brief: Our social app lets people write hashtags without spaces, like nightmarketfood. Before a tag goes to the search index, we want to know whether it can be read entirely as a run of terms from our approved vocabulary.

Implement canSplitIntoTerms(s, vocabulary), where s is the tag text without the hash sign and vocabulary lists the allowed terms, and return true if s can be cut into consecutive pieces that are each a vocabulary term, or false otherwise.
